summary: Supported RHEL for AAP 2.6: RPM on RHEL 9, containerized on RHEL 9 and RHEL 10, and OpenShift per the OpenShift life cycle policy.
questions: Which RHEL versions does containerized AAP 2.6 support?
Can I run AAP 2.6 on RHEL 8?

answer_card.title: RHEL support for AAP 2.6
answer_card.answer_md:
| Deployment | RHEL |
|---|---|
| RPM 2.6 | RHEL 9 |
| Containerized 2.6 | RHEL 9, RHEL 10 |
| OpenShift 2.6 | As included with OpenShift (see its life cycle policy) |
